# Hireytics — All-in-One AI Recruiting Platform & Recall Memory Engine

> Hireytics (https://hireytics.com) is an all-in-one AI-powered recruitment platform, automated voice interviewing tool, OCR resume screening ATS, and "Recall" — our semantic hiring memory & AI HR recruiting chatbot engine. Built specifically for mid-market companies (100–1,500 employees), technology scaleups, and agile talent acquisition teams in the United States (en-US) and United Kingdom (en-GB).

---

## Executive Summary & Value Proposition

* **All-in-One Platform Consolidation:** Replaces fragmented point solutions (separate ATS, video screening software, scheduling tools, and resume parsers) with a single unified hiring platform.
* **Affordable Mid-Market Pricing:** Eliminates $35,000–$60,000+ enterprise legacy contracts and per-seat recruiter penalties with flat, predictable plans ranging from $120 to $280 / month (or £95 to £220 / month).
* **Recall Semantic Memory Engine:** The first hiring system that acts as permanent institutional company memory, allowing talent teams and hiring managers to ask plain-language questions across candidate resumes, voice interview transcripts, and rubric scorecards with zero hallucinations.
* **Asynchronous AI Voice Screening:** Conducts structured conversational phone and web voice interviews with dynamic follow-up probing, timestamped transcription, and objective rubric scoring.

---

## Core End-to-End Recruitment Workflow

Hireytics automates the entire recruitment lifecycle through five interconnected stages:

1. **Requisition & Rubric Calibration:** Hiring managers input a job description or select a role template. Hireytics automatically generates calibrated evaluation rubrics, key competency vectors, and structured screening questions.
2. **OCR Resume Screening & Skill Vector Matching:** Ingests resumes from PDFs, Word documents, and scanned images. Evaluates candidates using contextual neural vector matching rather than primitive keyword matching.
3. **Asynchronous AI Voice Interviews:** Qualified candidates receive an invitation to an interactive voice screen. The AI conducts structured phone screens, asks dynamic follow-up questions, and generates clean transcripts.
4. **Recall Semantic Memory & HR Chatbot:** Every interaction, transcript, scorecard, and note is indexed into an institutional knowledge base. Recruiters and executives can query candidate context in plain language (e.g., "Recall, which backend candidates demonstrated hands-on Kubernetes migration experience?").
5. **Calibrated Scorecards & Candidate Onboarding:** Interview panels review standardized rubrics and 24-second candidate summaries, eliminating feedback bottlenecks and advancing top finalists to offer acceptance.

---

## Core Products & Capabilities

### 1. Recall — AI HR Chatbot & Candidate Memory Engine (`/recall`)
* **URL:** https://hireytics.com/recall
* **Purpose:** Institutional candidate memory platform and recruiting AI assistant.
* **Capabilities:**
  * Grounded natural-language retrieval with exact citations to resume lines, interview audio timestamps, and reviewer notes.
  * Cross-job applicant rediscovery (re-matches past silver medalists to new requisitions).
  * Strict tenant data isolation; candidate data is never used to train global third-party AI models.
  * Compliant with US EEOC standards and UK GDPR privacy frameworks.

### 2. AI Recruiting Suite (`/features/ai-recruiting`)
* **URL:** https://hireytics.com/features/ai-recruiting
* **Purpose:** Autonomous candidate qualification and sourcing.
* **Capabilities:** Multi-source pipeline parsing, automated qualification scoring, and direct integration with existing sourcing pipelines.

### 3. Candidate Screening & OCR Resume Parsing (`/features/candidate-screening`)
* **URL:** https://hireytics.com/features/candidate-screening
* **Purpose:** High-accuracy automated resume screening.
* **Capabilities:** Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for PDFs/images, skill vector semantic matching, and automated candidate ranking.

### 4. AI Voice Interviewing Software (`/features/automated-interviews`)
* **URL:** https://hireytics.com/features/automated-interviews
* **Purpose:** Asynchronous audio screening and structured evaluations.
* **Capabilities:** No app downloads required for candidates, real-time speech-to-text transcription, dynamic follow-up questions, and acoustic anti-cheat verification.

### 5. Applicant Tracking System (ATS) (`/features/applicant-tracking`)
* **URL:** https://hireytics.com/features/applicant-tracking
* **Purpose:** Pipeline management and team collaboration.
* **Capabilities:** Customizable hiring pipeline stages, panel scorecards, automated alerts, and bi-directional ATS connectors (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Slack).
